page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c9ae.4xlarge is a compute-optimized virtual machine instance running on the KVM hypervisor. It features 16 dedicated vCPUs powered by an AMD EPYC 9T95 processor with an x86_64 architecture and a clock speed of 2.25 GHz. The instance is configured with 32.0 GB of system memory, yielding a resource density of 2.0 GB of RAM per vCPU.

This server does not include local storage or integrated GPU hardware, meaning all storage requirements must be met via network-attached block storage. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 10 Gbps. The dedicated CPU allocation ensures consistent processing capabilities without resource contention from other tenants.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the 1:2 vCPU-to-RAM ratio positions this instance as a resource-dense option for compute-heavy workloads that do not require massive memory footprints. Appropriate workloads include batch processing, web serving, distributed analytics, and compute-intensive application servers.
